title: Improving Language Model Personas via Rationalization with Psychological Scaffolds

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the predictive accuracy of language model personas on opinion prediction tasks across different user education levels (e.g., high school, undergraduate, postgraduate) to evaluate performance disparities.

Evaluating the model's predictive performance across different racial groups (e.g., Asian, Black, Hispanic, Mixed Race, White) to ensure the personalization method works robustly without demographic-specific performance gaps.
Comparing opinion prediction accuracy across different user income brackets to measure potential performance disparities.
Assessing the predictive accuracy of simulated personas across different genders (Female, Male) to check for equitable task performance.
Evaluating predictive accuracy across various user age demographics (e.g., 18-29, 30-49, 50-64, 65+) to ensure robust personalization.
Comparing the performance of the persona model across different political ideologies (e.g., Conservative, Liberal, Moderate) and political party affiliations.
Evaluating predictive accuracy across various religious identities (e.g., Agnostic, Atheist, Christian, Muslim) and frequencies of religious attendance.
